i94.a2_rule: the recorded flow at the last measured section as quoted (whole veh/h) -3 % / +5 %, each end rounded to whole veh/h (docs/I24_DISCHARGE_DIAGNOSIS.md §7.5 (b), §8.3 A2)
i94.reason: the fleet is EIDM, whose car-following core is the improved IDM: below the desired speed its equilibrium gap is s0 + v T whatever the desired speed (measured on this fleet and read in SUMO's MSCFModel_EIDM, docs/WEAVE_MODEL_PLAN.md WP-68 and WP-73), so no factor moves its equilibrium flow at v_bar; at the unscaled limit (v0 = v_bar) it may stand at any gap from s0 + v T up, i.e. at any flow up to iidm_equilibrium_flow_at_v_bar_veh_h_lane, which the recorded flow is below (so the boundary as posted does not cap the recorded flow in equilibrium)
